<cite ref="Berakhot 28a:13">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>גדרוש מר חדא ש׳ וכ׳</he> shall one (of them) preach one Sabbath, and the other the next Sabbath (alternately)? There will be jealousy.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>דיזיף ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="J00263"><he>יְזַף</he></cite>. 118ᵃ, a. fr. <he>מעלי ש׳</he>, v. <cite ref="M02127"><he>מֵעֲלָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 38b:7">Gitt. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>דקבעי … בש׳ וכ׳</he> who have their meals on the Sabbath during lecturing hours.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 2:6:2">Y. Ber. II, 5ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חזיא … בשו׳ וכ׳</he> saw mourners on the Sabbath, and saluted them; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שַׁבְּתַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="U00204"><he>שַׁבְּתֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Hosea 2:13">Targ. Hos. II, 13</cite> <he>שַׁבְּתָהָא</he> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="U00201"><he>שַׁבַּתָּ׳</he></cite>).—Ber. l. c. <he>לדרוש … תלתא ש׳ וכ׳</he> let R. G. lecture three Sabbaths in succession, and R. El. b. Az. every fourth Sabbath.
